definitions.explanation: The deepest, most fundamental origin or cause of something. Often used for abstract concepts like problems, power, or life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根源|こんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧。
examples.english: To investigate the root of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪|あく}→悪：10459_aku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根源|こんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}た→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must cut off the root of evil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根源|こんげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The root cause of conflict is said to lie in resource scarcity.

notes:
A formal word that emphasizes the deepest, most fundamental level of causation or origin. Often used in philosophical, analytical, or problem-solving contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根源|こんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧: to seek the root cause
- {根源|こんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧: to eliminate the root cause
- {根源|こんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to lie at the root of
- {根源的|こんげんてき}: fundamental, radical (adjective form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause — more general and everyday
- ⟦{根本|こんぽん}→根本：13107_konpon⟧: root, foundation — very close in meaning, slightly less formal
- ⟦{源|みなもと}→源：27896_minamoto⟧: source — can be more concrete (source of a river, etc.)
- ⟦{起源|きげん}→起源：17394_kigen⟧: origin — focuses on when/where something began
